correctness.rationale: For a=0, f(x)=|x|−1 reaches [−1,0] after finitely many iterations from every real x, then f²(u)=u with alternate v=−u−1. For b0=1−u,b1=2+u the two-step scalar G(y)=||y|−b0|−b1 admits an absorbing interval: when u<−1/2, G(y)=t−|y| (t=−1−2u>0) on [−b0,b0] and finite subtract/add returns reach [0,t]; for u>−1/2, orbits descend by b1−b0 to J=[−2−u,u−1], where G(y)=−3−y; on u=−1/2, G(y)=−|y| and is identity after entering [−3/2,0]. Thus entire planar periodic locus is P with T⁴|P=id, planar area integral ∫_{−1}^0|1+2u|du=1/2, one fixed point (−1/2,−3/4), and 2/4 least periods as stated. For 0<c<1, scalar return Gc is globally c²-Lipschitz, unique fixed cycle and pointwise singular graph selection. Check boundary u=−1,−1/2,0 and the central zero-area segment. Finite rational checker is only corroboration.
